Hi Chloe,

Thanks for making time to connect last week — John (our CIO) is keen to see a short platform demo focused on inference economics and dedicated deployments. He prefers to attend in person or on video rather than delegate. Our preferred window is next Tuesday/Wednesday (May 11–12) between 09:00–12:00 PT.

Can you confirm whether a VP-level sponsor from Redwood can join one of those slots? If not, can you propose an alternate slot where a VP or your lead technical sponsor can attend?

I've attached a short RFI with questions the team will review before the demo (atlascloud-rfi.pdf).

Thanks,

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and for sending the RFI. Quick summary: we absolutely want John present; VP-level sponsorship is important here.

Reality check: our VP who typically runs these exec demos (Ellen Torres) is out of office the week of May 11–15 due to a pre-scheduled customer trip. I can (a) escalate to our CTO for a join, (b) schedule the demo earlier the week of May 4–7, or (c) broker a slot-swap with another prospect where Ellen is committed now but can trade with you for John’s preferred time. Option (c) is fastest if you need the VP specifically.

Proposal: if you're flexible about exact time on May 11–12, we can move John’s preferred Tuesday 10:00 PT slot to Wednesday 11:00 PT and then try to re-home our existing commitment for Tuesday through a swap. That gets Ellen (VP) in the room and minimizes churn. If that works, I’ll coordinate internally and send a calendar invite.

Attached our latest demo deck and the VP-level agenda (redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf). Also adding a quick checklist:
- 30–40 minute demo (platform + dedicated capacity use cases)
- 10–15 minute Q&A with John
- Follow-up: technical deep-dive with engineering (if requested)

Which of your slots is most flexible?

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

John really prefers to be present, so the slot-swap sounds reasonable. If you can confirm by end of day today, we'll hold both Tue 10:00 and Wed 11:00 tentatively.

One ask: can you include a senior product person on the call who can speak to dedicated/private deployment SLAs (latency guarantees, regional isolation)? If Ellen can't make it, having Jordan on the call as backup would be fine.

I'll hold the two slots and await your confirmation.
